integrity: The proof uses published exact theorems with an explicit bridge through vertex-transitive distance colorings. The lower construction and upper bound use the same convention that distance \(0\) is counted. Arithmetic parameter conversion was independently replayed by the bundled checker.
limitations: Finite \(1\)-homogeneous metric spaces only; this determines the extremal number of attained distances but does not classify all extremal spaces. The upper bound imports Edmonds' published involution/odd-valency theorem. Targeted searches found no prior statement of the closed metric formula, but unindexed independent observation remains a residual risk.
title: Complete exact formula for \(\Delta_1(n)\) in finite \(1\)-homogeneous metric spaces
